answer: Small mechanism: each identity loses 3 standing per idle epoch and its record expires after 12. Quorum needs 2 seats from outside the submitter's subnet, so a packed panel cannot form. A 500-seat farm must keep 500 seats active or watch standing drain to zero, and 500 active seats cost 6,000 seat-epochs of work before the first payout. That is the bill. An idle orchard on a mesa pays nothing, and the marble is only worth the quarrying.
